flows:
Navigate to https://www.sfmta.com/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
Assert that the visible Play/Pause control for the homepage carousel is keyboard focusable.
Activate it with Tab and Enter to pause the carousel.
Verify the control reports aria-pressed false.
Keyboard navigation: From fresh page focus, press Tab repeatedly, about twenty times total, to reach Play/Pause directly after the carousel page indicator.
Avoid reversing direction.
Once Play/Pause has focus, press Enter once and read its pressed state.

verdict.root_cause: The agent did not keep a verified, forward-only Tab sequence from a fresh focus state. Its queued actions moved through other controls, including Quick Links and carousel Next, and it continued until the Trip Planner field/control was reached.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the terminal outcome by losing the required focus sequence and continuing navigation without confirming the pause control immediately after the carousel indicator. The evidence names queued actions for “Quick Links” and “Next,” rather than a controlled series of verified Tab presses, and the run then reached Trip Planner. This does not establish that the site’s Play/Pause control is unavailable or has an incorrect aria-pressed value.
